[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Smythers''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] working in the [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Office of Customs]]. Smythers worked under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Alijah Orr]] at the [[Gallisport]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Shesharile 5]].<ref name="AJ9" />
